objective: Localize which semantic six-bucket families C={C+,C-}, D={D+,D-}, and A={A+,A-} require the 3+ saturation state inside the common owner-symmetric signed-parity exchange carrier, using a complete frozen family-specific transform grid before scalar replay.

familyModes.name: PRESENCE
familyModes.definition: For both plus/minus buckets in the family retain only [n>0].

familyModes.name: ZOE
familyModes.definition: For both plus/minus buckets in the family retain Z if n=0, O if n>0 is odd, E if n>0 is even.

familyModes.name: CLIP2
familyModes.definition: For both plus/minus buckets in the family retain 0,1,2+.

familyModes.name: CLIP3
familyModes.definition: For both plus/minus buckets in the family retain 0,1,2,3+.

candidateGrid.construction: Complete Cartesian product of familyModes independently assigned to C, D, and A.

structuralProcedure: Start from each frozen EW-RS-074 D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS six-bucket pair signature.
Apply the C family transform uniformly to C+ and C-.
Apply the D family transform uniformly to D+ and D-.
Apply the A family transform uniformly to A+ and A-.
Form each OOO triple key as the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair signatures.
Freeze candidate feature catalogs, matched-dependency rows, and structural bases before scalar replay.

partialOrder.familyOrder: PRESENCE and ZOE are incomparable; CLIP2 and CLIP3 are ordered only by explicit information containment where applicable.
partialOrder.dominance: Candidate X is strictly coarser than Y only if every family transform in X is structurally no finer than the corresponding transform in Y and at least one is strictly coarser.
partialOrder.output: Report all Pareto-minimal common-exact candidates; do not force a single winner among incomparable count algebras.

measurements: kernel dimension relative to uniform CLIP3
antiCircularity: The three bucket families, four family modes, complete 64-point grid, pair grouping, and partial-order rule are frozen before scalar inspection.
No plus/minus bucket is split independently.
No family-specific threshold or exception is added after seeing W/D/L.
The EW-RS-074 owner quotient and EW-RS-065 matched dependencies remain unchanged.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: Uniform C=CLIP3,D=CLIP3,A=CLIP3 must reproduce EW-RS-075 ranks 72,253,14 with zero contradictions.
Any candidate with zero structural residue and nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No outcome-driven family-specific rescue or per-sign exception is allowed.
nextIfFamilyCompressionPasses: Freeze all Pareto-minimal common-exact family-specific saturation laws, then test plus/minus channel coupling and small circuit functionals only within those frozen minima.
nextIfOnlyUniformClip3Passes: Retain uniform CLIP3 and move to outcome-independent six-bucket circuit/basis reduction rather than bucket-specific coefficient fitting.
interpretationGuards: This experiment localizes count saturation only within the late six-bucket exchange carrier.
A coarser transform on one family does not imply that transform is valid at upstream component-multiplicity or other count layers.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
